verses.text: God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.

segments.text: God standeth in the congregation of God;

verses.text: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? [Selah

segments.text: How long will ye judge unjustly,
And respect the persons of the wicked? [Selah

verses.text: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

segments.text: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

verses.text: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

segments.text: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.text: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

segments.text: They know not, neither do they understand;
They walk to and fro in darkness:
All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.text: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.

segments.text: And all of you sons of the Most High.

verses.text: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.

segments.text: Nevertheless ye shall die like men,
And fall like one of the princes.

verses.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.

segments.text: Arise, O God, judge the earth;
For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
